_about: Fixture metadata for docs/contracts/fixtures/*.json. Each fixture file is a pure redacted wire-shape sample; documentation lives here so the JSON files can be parsed as if they came off the wire. See scripts/validate-fixtures.mjs for invariants enforced at lint time.

_shape.id: Stable fixture id; matches the file stem.
_shape.resource: For REST: the response type. For WS frames: the event/frame type.
_shape.source: Upstream handler/path this sample was read from.
_shape.direction: For WS frames only: 'client -> server' or 'server -> client'.
_shape.scope: For WS frames only: which scope receives this frame (workspace | user | task | chat | n/a).

fixtures.redaction: JWT truncated to header.payload.signature shape; signature is redacted. Embedded user object is a redacted copy of user-response.json.
Custom env + MCP config are server-redacted; the fixture mirrors the redacted shape.
All UUIDs are synthetic; names and emails are placeholders.
Synthetic UUIDs; download URLs are placeholders.
JWT truncated to header.payload.signature shape; signature is redacted. This is the only frame a bearer-only client may send before auth_ack.
Synthetic UUID; no payload fields contain secrets.
Embedded comment + issue summary are redacted copies of comment-response.json + issue-response.json so the wire frame stands on its own.
Embedded issue is a redacted copy of issue-response.json so the wire frame stands on its own.
